Stereon benchmark trend

Latest: 1425d78 on 2026-11-11, AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor. Hosted runners differ from run to run, so a step in a chart is read against the CPU in its points' titles. The change shown is against the run before; above 10% it is marked.
